reference.def: A value through which code can reach an object.

stack frame.def: The local variables and operand stack of one method invocation.

class file.def: A file describing a compiled type and the instructions for its methods.

conditional write.def: A change applied only when the current value matches the expected value.

iload_0.def: Copy the integer in local slot zero onto the operand stack.

iconst_1.def: Push the integer constant one onto the operand stack.

root.def: A starting point from which the runtime traces live references.

garbage collector.def: The part of the runtime that automatically reclaims storage for objects the program can no longer reach.

bytecode.def: The instructions inside a class file; each one starts with a one-byte opcode.

opcode.def: The single byte at the start of an instruction that says which operation to perform.

byte offset.def: The number javap prints before an instruction: where it starts, counted in bytes from the start of the method.

type letter.def: The first letter of many instruction names, giving the type it works on: i for int, l for long, a for a reference.

iadd.def: Remove two integers from the operand stack and push their sum.

ireturn.def: Hand the integer on top of the operand stack to the caller and finish the call.

imul.def: Remove two integers from the operand stack and push their product.

isub.def: Remove two integers and push the deeper one minus the top one.

iload.def: Copy the integer in a local slot onto the operand stack.

istore.def: Remove the integer on top of the operand stack and write it into a local slot.

iconst_2.def: Push the integer constant two onto the operand stack.

bipush.def: Push a small integer carried in the instruction itself (one extra byte).

sipush.def: Push an integer carried in the instruction itself (two extra bytes).

ScoreKt.def: The class kotlinc creates for the top-level functions of Score.kt.

constant pool.def: The numbered table at the start of a class file holding the names, texts and numbers its code refers to.

descriptor.def: A type written in the class file short code: I for int, J for long, L plus a class name for a reference; for a method, (parameters) then the return type.

symbolic reference.def: A reference to a class, field or method by its name and descriptor, which the JVM looks up while the program runs.

getstatic.def: Read a static field, named through the constant pool, and push its value.

ldc.def: Push a constant stored in the constant pool.

Fieldref.def: A constant-pool entry describing a field: its class plus its name and descriptor.

NameAndType.def: A constant-pool entry pairing a name with a descriptor.

Utf8.def: A constant-pool entry holding a piece of text.

receiver.def: The object a method is called on; inside the method it arrives in local slot 0.

bootstrap method.def: A method an invokedynamic instruction names; the JVM runs it once, the first time, to decide what the call does.

invokestatic.def: Call a static method: exactly the one the constant pool names.

invokespecial.def: Call exactly the named instance method: a constructor, a super call, a Kotlin private method.

invokevirtual.def: Call a method declared in a class, choosing the version in the receiver class.

invokeinterface.def: Call a method declared in an interface, choosing the version in the receiver class.

invokedynamic.def: A call whose target a bootstrap method decides the first time it runs.

<init>.def: The name a constructor has inside a class file.

aload.def: Copy the reference in a local slot onto the operand stack.

astore.def: Remove the reference on top of the stack and write it into a local slot.

istore_1.def: Store the top integer in local slot 1.

getfield.def: Read a field of the object whose reference is on top of the stack.

getter.def: A generated method that returns a property field, such as getVisits().

setter.def: A generated method that stores its argument in a property field, such as setVisits(int).

mask.def: The extra int a $default method receives: bit n is set when argument n was left out.

visit$default.def: The method kotlinc generates to fill in default arguments of visit.

Bookmark$Companion.def: The class kotlinc generates for the companion object of Bookmark.

BookmarkKt.def: The class holding the top-level functions of Bookmark.kt.

checkNotNullParameter.def: The Kotlin runtime check that throws when a non-null parameter receives null.

@JvmStatic.def: Kotlin annotation: also generate a real static method for a companion function.

@JvmOverloads.def: Kotlin annotation: generate one overload per default argument for Java callers.

@JvmName.def: Kotlin annotation: choose the JVM name of a generated method.

iand.def: Remove two integers and push the bits set in both.

ifeq.def: Jump to the given offset if the integer on top is zero.

isOpen.def: A property name starting with is, whose getter keeps the name.

getIsOpen.def: The getter name Kotlin does not generate for isOpen.

getUrl.def: The getter kotlinc generates for val url.

function object.def: An object with one invoke() method that runs a lambda, carrying the values the lambda captured.

inline function.def: A Kotlin function whose body, and the lambdas passed to it, kotlinc copies into each caller.

call site.def: One place in the code where a call is written, such as one invokedynamic instruction.

Function0.def: Kotlin interface for a function with no parameters; its method is invoke().

LambdaMetafactory.def: The JDK class whose bootstrap method creates lambda classes while the program runs.

main$lambda$0.def: The private static method holding the lambda body.

istore_0.def: Store the top integer in local slot 0.

LambdasKt.def: The class holding the top-level functions of Lambdas.kt.

HotSpot.def: The JVM inside OpenJDK, the one java runs in this course.

method table.def: HotSpot per-class list with one entry per overridable method, at the same position as in the parent class.

OpenJDK.def: The open-source project that builds the JDK, including HotSpot.

class loading.def: Finding a class file bytes and creating the class in memory, the first time code needs the class.

verification.def: The linking step that checks a class bytecode is safe to run before any of it runs.

preparation.def: The linking step that creates a class static fields with default values (0, null).

resolution.def: Turning a symbolic reference into the real class, field or method it names.

linking.def: Verification, preparation and resolution: making a loaded class ready to run.

initialization.def: Running a class static code, once, at its first real use.

static initializer.def: All of a class's static code, compiled into one method, <clinit>, that initialization runs once.

<clinit>.def: The class-file name of a class's static initializer.

putstatic.def: Write the value on top of the stack into a static field.

ExceptionInInitializerError.def: Thrown the first time a class's static initializer throws; its cause is the real error.

NoClassDefFoundError.def: Thrown when running code needs a class that can't be used: gone since compilation, or failed to initialize.

NumberFormatException.def: Thrown when text can't be read as a number.

class loader.def: An object that finds a class's bytes by name and asks the JVM to create the class from them.

parent delegation.def: The rule that a class loader asks its parent for a class before looking in its own places.

defining loader.def: The class loader that actually created a class; with the name, it identifies the class while the program runs.

ClassLoader.def: The JDK class every class loader except bootstrap is an instance of.

PlatformClassLoader.def: How the platform class loader prints itself.

AppClassLoader.def: How the application (system) class loader prints itself.

URLClassLoader.def: A JDK class loader that reads class files from the folders or jars you give it.

ClassCastException.def: Thrown when an object is cast to a class it isn't an instance of.

LinkageError.def: Thrown when linking finds an inconsistency, such as two loaders disagreeing about a class.

class path.def: The list of folders and jars, given with -cp, where the application class loader looks for classes.

module path.def: The list of folders and jars holding Java modules, given with -p; required modules are checked before main runs.

ClassNotFoundException.def: Thrown when code asks a loader for a class by a name in a string and no loader has it.

FindException.def: Thrown at startup when a required module isn't on the module path.

NoSuchMethodError.def: Thrown when compiled code calls a method the loaded class doesn't have.

Class.forName.def: Load a class by a name given as a string.

heap.def: The memory where objects live, managed by the garbage collector.

metaspace.def: Memory outside the heap where HotSpot keeps class metadata, in chunks owned by each class loader.

class unloading.def: Freeing a loader's classes together with the loader, once nothing reachable leads to them.

OutOfMemoryError.def: Thrown when the JVM can't get memory it needs; its message names which kind, such as Metaspace.

ThreadLocal.def: A JDK class that keeps one value per thread.

PermGen.def: The permanent generation: where class metadata lived on the heap before JDK 8.

MaxMetaspaceSize.def: The HotSpot option that sets an upper limit on metaspace.

register.def: In DEX, a numbered slot of the method's frame that an instruction names as an input or output.

desugaring.def: d8 rewriting newer Java features, such as lambdas, into simpler code older Android versions can run.

d8.def: The Android build tool that converts class files into DEX.

PathClassLoader.def: The class loader Android uses for apps.

MyActivity.def: An example class name from Android's R8 documentation.

string_ids.def: The DEX table listing every string a DEX file uses.

vAA.def: A register operand in Android's DEX instruction reference.

vBB.def: A register operand in Android's DEX instruction reference.

vCC.def: A register operand in Android's DEX instruction reference.
